summary: Kerb at a junction with painted island, blocking a gravel track mouth.
reasons: Junction kerb with painted traffic island
Van would block gravel track entrance

drivers.seclusion: Open junction in view of passing traffic; homes are 40 m or more away.
drivers.access_and_room: The stretch runs along a junction with a painted island and across the mouth of a gravel track, so there is no clear room to pull out of the lane.
drivers.convention: No parked cars at this kerb and no signs.

flags: Low-lying: 2.4-3.2 m elevation, Toowong Creek 80 m away
sun_shade: Open to sun; trees shade the north-west and south.
